description: An action button on the business page, for example "Schedule now" or "Get directions". The type sets what the action does and which options it accepts.

business_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business that owns the action (e.g., "ea0tpkm5j3q86uaa").

business_page_uid.description: Unique identifier of the business page that shows the action (e.g., "k2xw9q4m7zt1h8ba").

type.description: What the action does. It cannot change after the action is created. **schedule**: book an appointment or event. **pay**: make a payment. **package**: buy a package. **contact**: leave a message. **document**: upload a document. **call**: call a phone number. **googlemaps**: show a map. **youtube**, **vimeo**, **dailymotion**: play a video (new dailymotion actions cannot be created). **link**, **pdf**: open a URL in a new tab. **text**: show a text page. **facebook**, **twitter**, **instagram**: open a social profile (e.g., "schedule", "call").

title.description: Title shown on the action button, up to 255 characters (e.g., "Schedule now").

description.description: Text shown under the title (e.g., "Pick a time that suits you" or null).

position.description: Zero-based place of the action on the page. In an update, the action moves to this place and the server shifts the other actions (e.g., 0, 1, 2).

active.description: Whether the owner turned the action on. An inactive action is not shown on the page (e.g., true, false).

icon.description: Name of the design-system icon shown on the action (e.g., "calendar", "phone").

button_type.description: How the action is drawn. **button**: icon and title. **image**: an image above the button. **text**: a text block above the button (e.g., "button", "image").

image_url.description: Absolute https URL of the action image. Required when button_type is "image", except for video and map actions, which show a preview (e.g., "https://res.cloudinary.com/livesite/image/upload/v1/LivesiteImages/action.jpg" or null).

button_text.description:
HTML text shown when button_type is "text". The server removes tags that are not on its allowlist (e.g., "

Open every day

" or null).

use_brand_colors.description: Whether the action uses the default action colours of the page. When false, background_color and text_color apply (e.g., true, false).

background_color.description: Background colour of this action as a 6-digit hex value, used when use_brand_colors is false (e.g., "#b3261e" or null).

text_color.description: Text colour of this action as a 6-digit hex value, used when use_brand_colors is false (e.g., "#ffffff" or null).

options.description: Settings of the action. The allowed keys depend on type, and other keys are rejected. **schedule**: service_uid, category_uid, event_uid, staff_uid, date (all optional). **pay**: title, amount, currency (all optional). **package**: package_uid (optional). **contact**: title, message (optional). **document**: no keys. **call**: phone_source ("business" or "custom"), phone. **googlemaps**: address_source ("business" or "custom"), address. **youtube**, **vimeo**, **dailymotion**: video_url (required). **link**, **pdf**: url (required). **text**: text (HTML; the server removes tags that are not on its allowlist). **facebook**, **twitter**, **instagram**: username (required) (e.g., {"service_uid": "srv8f3k2m1x9q7w5"}).

options_version.description: Version of the options format for this type (e.g., 1).

available.description: Whether the business has the feature that the action needs, for example online scheduling for a schedule action. The page does not show an action that is not available (e.g., true, false).

missing_info.description: Whether the action cannot work yet because business information is missing, for example a call action that uses the business phone when the business has none (e.g., true, false).

created_at.description: Time when the action was created (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").

updated_at.description: Time of the last change. Send this value back in an update to detect a conflicting change (e.g., "2026-11-13T10:30:00Z").
